exposure: oral estradiol (4 mg daily) in addition to progesterone
progesterone only (vaginal progesterone 400 mg twice daily and oral dydrogesterone 20 mg daily)
cohort: The study included 180 subfertile women aged 18-35 years undergoing ovarian stimulation and ICSI.
finding: The addition of oral estradiol to progesterone in patients undergoing ICSI did not significantly improve overall pregnancy outcomes, but it did significantly increase the implantation rate.
